name: com.banditdb/mcp
title: BanditDB
description: Persistent decision memory for agents — learns which action works in which context

environmentVariables.name: BANDITDB_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the BanditDB server, e.g. http://localhost:8080 or https://your-instance.api.banditdb.com. Try it against the public sandbox at https://sandbox.banditdb.com before running your own.

environmentVariables.name: BANDITDB_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key. A writer-role key is enough for get_intuition and record_outcome; admin is needed to create or delete campaigns.
